How It Works

## How Ellie works.

We set it up, Ellie runs it, you just do the work. Here's exactly what happens on every call.

![A customer smiling while calling a business on her phone](https://callellie.com/assets/ellie/1.png)

Step 1

### Customer calls your business

They dial your number, Ellie picks up every time, wherever you are.

![A small business owner relaxed, checking his phone in his workshop](https://callellie.com/assets/ellie/2.png)

Step 2

### Ellie answers in 2 seconds

Warm, professional, sounding just like your business, answered before the second ring.

![A customer smiling on a call in her car, chatting with Ellie](https://callellie.com/assets/ellie/3.png)

Step 3

### Handles questions politely

Tells callers about your services, answers FAQs, and guides them through what they need.

![A customer holding up her phone showing a text booking confirmation from Ellie](https://callellie.com/assets/ellie/4.png)

Step 4

### Books & sends details instantly

Takes their first name and sends full booking details straight to their phone number.

The Technology

## Why Ellie sounds like a real person, not a bot.

Most AI voices give themselves away within seconds. Ellie is built with natural Australian voices and fast, human-paced conversation. so your callers get a warm, professional answer, not a robotic script-reader.

**Real human voice library**

We license authentic Australian voice recordings, not synthetic speech. Your callers hear genuine warmth, natural rhythm, and real Australian intonation.

**Understands natural speech**

No menus, no "press 1 for sales." Callers just talk, interruptions, half-finished sentences and all, and Ellie follows the conversation.

**Built for Australian business**

From tradie call-outs to salon bookings to after-hours enquiries, Ellie speaks with a natural Australian voice, not a generic American AI.

**Fast, natural responses**

Ellie responds quickly, without the long robotic pauses that give away a bad AI system, so conversations stay natural and unhurried.

FAQ

## Common questions.

Will customers know Ellie is AI?


Most callers don't ask — Ellie sounds warm and natural. If someone does ask directly, she's honest about it and keeps helping with their enquiry.

Can I keep my existing phone number?


In most setups Ellie answers on a number that forwards from your existing line, so you don't need to reprint signage or update Google. We'll confirm the exact setup for your business during onboarding.

What happens if Ellie doesn't know an answer?


She doesn't guess. Ellie takes a message and flags it for your team rather than inventing pricing, hours or details she hasn't been given.

Can Ellie transfer calls to me?


Intelligent live call transfer is coming soon. Right now, if a call needs a human, Ellie takes a detailed message and notifies your team so you can follow up quickly.

Can Ellie book appointments?


Yes. Ellie checks your calendar availability, books appointments directly into supported calendars, and sends an SMS confirmation to the customer.

Does Ellie work after hours?


Yes — Ellie answers 24/7, including nights, weekends and public holidays, so after-hours enquiries never go to voicemail.

Can I choose when Ellie answers?


Yes. Ellie can be your full-time receptionist, or step in only after hours or when a call is missed — you decide.

Can Ellie handle multiple calls at once?


Yes — because Ellie runs in the cloud rather than as a single physical line, she can answer more than one call at a time, so customers don't hit a busy signal.

Can I listen to calls?


Yes. Every call is recorded and available in your dashboard, so you can review exactly what was said.

Can I cancel anytime?


Yes. There's no lock-in contract — it's month-to-month, and you can cancel anytime.

How does the 7-day trial work?


Request a callback, we build your Ellie within 24 hours, and you get 7 days free to see how she handles real calls before you pay anything. No credit card required to start.

What happens after the founding offer?


Your $99/month founding rate stays locked in for as long as your subscription remains active. Once the first 10 spots are filled, new customers join at the regular $199/month rate.

Is my customer data secure?


Calls and business details are handled with privacy in mind. Read our [Privacy Policy](https://callellie.com/privacy) for exactly what's collected and how it's used.

How quickly can I get set up?


Most businesses go live within 24 hours of their callback. Ellie learns your business from your website in seconds — we handle the rest.
